statement: You are given an integer array nums and an integer k. A subsequence picks any set of positions of nums, keeping their order.
Return true if at least one subsequence has elements that add up to exactly k, and false otherwise. The empty subsequence has sum 0.
The pick / not-pick recursion can stop as soon as one branch reports a match, instead of exploring the whole tree.

examples.explanation: Picking 2 and 3 gives 5, so the answer is true.
Even taking every element gives only 6, so no subsequence reaches 100.
